snippet.title: HellHeart Breaker Updated Trailer |  Featured on SEA Game Showcase 2026
snippet.description:
From the folks who brought you Cuisineer, comes a hack and slash action roguelite... with a dating sim!

HellHeart Breaker - the monster girls you date grant you newfound powers, and the girls you don't... are the bosses you fight!

In this dungeon-crawler roguelite, you are locked away at the bottom of the Underworld, fighting your way out.

If all is fair in love and war - what will you do?

7 different clans wish to break you out - each with its own agenda.
-9 different planned endings
-35 different weapons, from the jian to the katar, master a deadly arsenal in your quest upwards
-7 different elemental trees and an assortment of augments
-7 different worlds to wander and battle through
-Customisable outfits and home
-Fishing!
-Loads of food at the Kappa Market
-No, you can't fix her
